questions.question: The skirt does______ at the back.
questions.explanation: do up- to be fastened, বাধা থাকা, আটকে থাকা। Does this skirt do up at the side or at the back?do up = wrap, মোড়ানো/মোড়া। He was carrying a package done up in brown paper.

questions.question: We have_______ the rules in order to simplify the process.
questions.explanation: Do away with (abolish, আইন বাতিল করা, বিলোপ করা; stop using something, কোনো কিছুর সমাপ্তি ঘটানো) This law should be done away with.

questions.question: Not a word fell_______ his lips.
questions.explanation: Fall from (come out, বের হওয়া) Not a word fell from his lips. (তার মুখ থেকে একটা কথাও বের হলো না)

questions.question: Instead of 'deteriorate' we can say______.
questions.explanation: Fall off (decline, deteriorate, কমে যাওয়া) The quality of goods has fallen off.

questions.question: Bashir gets_____ well with his colleagues.
questions.explanation: Get in with : become popular or friendly with someone, কারও নিকট জনপ্রিয় বা বন্ধুসুলভ হওয়া।Get on with : have a good relationship, কারও সাথে সুসম্পর্ক থাকা, সুসম্পর্ক বজায় রাখা।

questions.question: It's no longer possible to get by ______ a dollar a day.
questions.explanation: get by (on money)-manage or deal with, অর্থের দ্বারা চালিয়ে নেওয়া বা চালিয়ে নিতে সক্ষম হওয়া।How can/does he get by on so little money/such a small salary? (সে কীভাবে এত কম টাকায় চলে?

questions.question: The police are looking _____ the case.
questions.explanation: Look into something - তদন্ত করা।

questions.question: I could not _______ the meaning of the passage.
questions.explanation: Make out (understand, discern, বুঝতে পারা, উপলব্ধি করা) I can't make out his words.

questions.question: We requested the chairperson to ______ the meeting until tomorrow.
questions.explanation: Put off (postpone, স্থগিত করা, ফেলে রাখা) Don't put off until tomorrow what you can do today.

questions.question: While living in poverty, the poet had to _____ a great deal of sufferings.un
questions.explanation: Put up with (tolerate, endure, সহ্য করা) I cannot put up with such insults.

questions.question: The judge _____ my objection.
questions.explanation: Set down (record, লিখে নেয়া) The judge set down my objection.

questions.question: I took _____ walking, hoping ____ lose some weight.
questions.explanation: Take to (অভ্যস্ত হওয়া) এর পরে verb + ing বসে এবং hope (verb) এর পরে to + base form বসে।

questions.question: Which one is correct for "দয়া করে আপনার জুতা খুলুন"?
options: Please take out of your shoes.
questions.explanation: Take on/put on/ have on/ do on পরিধান করা; take off/put off/have off/ do off -খুলে ফেলা

questions.question: Your report( bears out ) his history. What is the meaning of the bracketed phrasal verb of the sentence?
questions.explanation: Bear out (Support, Confirm, সমর্থন করা) His evidence does not bear out the charge.

questions.question: The student( broke off) in the middle of the debate. What is the meaning of the bracketed phrasal verb of the sentence?
questions.explanation: Break off (stop suddenly, হঠাৎ থামা) The teacher broke off in the middle of his speech.

questions.question: 'On behalf of' means 'act for'. True or false?
questions.explanation: Act for (act on behalf of, কারো হয়ে কিছু করা) The lawyer acts for the clients.

questions.question: His pride has _____ his ruin.
questions.explanation: Bring about (cause to happen, ঘটানো) He tried to bring about a quarrel between us.

questions.question: The widow then burst _____ tears at the sad news.
questions.explanation: Burst into tears (start to cry suddenly, হঠাৎ কান্নায় ভেঙ্গে পড়া) The girl burst into tears.oBurst out laughing/crying (suddenly say sth loudly, ফেটে পড়া) He burst out laughing.

questions.question: I called ____ his address on the computer.
questions.explanation: call up = stored or kept available (She called up her last reserve of strength.)

questions.question: He comes_____ a noble family.
questions.explanation: জন্মগ্রহণ করা বুঝাতে Traditional grammar এ come of ব্যবহৃত হয় এবং Modem grammar 4 come from ব্যবহৃত হয়। যেমন: He comes of a good family. (TG) He comes from a good family. (MG)

questions.question: Instead of 'Continue' which word may be used-
questions.explanation: Carry on (continue, চালিয়ে যাওয়া) He will carry on the business.

questions.question: My nephew ______ chicken pox this weeken.
questions.explanation: Come down with (become ill with, খুব গুরুতর নয় এমন রোগে আক্রান্ত হওয়া)

questions.question: He cut _____ a slice of the cake for me
questions.explanation: Cut off (die, মারা যাওয়া) He was cut off at an early age. He was cut off in the prime of life.Cut off (separate, বিচ্ছিন্ন) He lives in a foreign country, cut off from his kith and kin.Cut off (separate, কেটে বিচ্ছিন্ন করা) Our water supply was cut off for two days last week.

questions.question: Which one is wrong?
options: Die through -অযত্নে বা অবহেলায় মারা যাওয়া
Die from ক্ষত, জখম, আঘাত, অতিরিক্ত কোনো কিছুর পরিণতিরূপে মারা যাওয়া
questions.explanation: Die of (অসুস্থতা, ক্ষুধা, তৃষ্ণা, রোগে মারা যাওয়া)Die down (become weaker, দুর্বলতর হওয়া)

questions.question: If I thought I could ______it, I wouldn't pay my taxes at all.
questions.explanation: get away with- succeed in avoiding punishment for sth= কোন কিছুর সাজা বা শাস্তি এড়াতে সক্ষম হওয়া

questions.question: The company came ____ strong criticism from the public.
questions.explanation: came under-অধীন হওয়া, শিকার হওয়া। বাক্যের অর্থ: কোম্পানিটি জনগণের কড়া সমালোচনার শিকার হলো

questions.question: I loved the trip. The beautiful scenery ____ the awful roads.
questions.explanation: make up for- compensate, ক্ষতিপূরণ দেয়া, পুষিয়ে দেয়া, পূরণ করা

questions.question: She _____ a brief appearance at the end of the party.
questions.explanation: put in a brief appearance - be present somewhere for a short time -কিছুক্ষণের জন্য উপস্থিত হওয়া

questions.question: Nobody believed Ahmed at first but he _____ to be right.
questions.explanation: Turn out to be/have (sth) = to be known or discovered finally and surprisingly; to prove to be, সবশেষে কোনো কিছু বিস্ময়করভাবে জানতে পারা, আবিষ্কার করা; অবশেষে প্রমাণিত হওয়া

questions.question: The phrasal verb 'write off' means-
questions.explanation: write off-to cancel/cancelling a debt, ঋণ বাতিল বলে গণ্য করা, পরিশোধ করতে হবে না বলে মেনে নেয়া।

questions.question: The Bangladesh Cricket team_____ with a victory against England
questions.explanation: bounce back -recover, রোগ, ব্যর্থতা, সমস্যা কাটিয়ে উঠে স্বাস্থ্যবান, আত্মবিশ্বাসী ও সফল হতে শুরু করা।Children often seem to bounce back from illness more quickly than adults do.

questions.question: Several new diseases ____ in the recent years.
questions.explanation: come up -appear, উপস্থিত হওয়া, দেখা দেয়া; বাক্যের অর্থ: সাম্প্রতিক বছরগুলোতে কতিপয় নতুন রোগ দেখা

questions.question: Sometimes kids ( act up ) because they just want attention. Here "act up" means -
questions.explanation: act up - to behave badly, (বাচ্চাদের দ্বারা) খারাপ আচরণ করা

questions.question: Instead of eating at home, we decided to_____.
questions.explanation: eat out = eat in a restaurant, রেস্টুরেন্টে খাওয়া; eat up = কাউকে প্রদত্ত খাবার সব খেয়ে সাবাড় করা/শেষ করা

questions.question: Alcohol tells _____ your health.
questions.explanation: Tell upon- harm, affect, have a bad effect (শরীর, স্বাস্থ্যের) মারাত্মক ক্ষতি করা, হানি ঘটানো।

questions.question: Trees have _____ off their leaves.
questions.explanation: cast aside/off - get rid of, পরিত্যাগ করা, ছেড়ে দেওয়া, মুক্ত হওয়া; Throw off- আরোগ্য হওয়া, কাপড় খুলে ফেলা; fall off- কমে যাওয়া: put off- স্থগিত করা, (কাজ) ফেলে রাখা, কাপড় খুলে ফেলা

questions.question: I called the hotel, but they said they were booked_____.
questions.explanation: Book up- সম্পূর্ণ বুকিং করা

questions.question: The project___ for want of funds.
questions.explanation: fall down (মাটিতে) পড়ে যাওয়া; fall away কমে যাওয়া, খসে পড়া, ঝরে পড়া।fall back - retreat, সরে আসা, পিছু হটা; fall through (পরিকল্পনা, প্রকল্প) ব্যর্থ হওয়া, সম্পূর্ণ না হওয়া

questions.question: Let us not_____ your past mistakes.
questions.explanation: dwell on/upon কোনো কিছু নিয়ে চিন্তাভাবনা করা বা বিশদভাবে আলোচনা করা।

questions.question: The phrase 'Tide over' means:
questions.explanation: Tide over overcome, (বিপদ/সমস্যা) কাটিয়ে উঠা, পার করা, কাটিয়ে উঠতে সাহায্য করা; cross over (the road) = রাস্তা পার হওয়া; pass (sb/sth) over ignore, উপেক্ষা করা; carry over- হিসাবের জের টানা
